name: las-medulas-roman-gold-mine
friendly_name: Roman Gold Mine at Las Medulas
description: After conquering the northwest of Iberia, Roman engineers used aqueducts to wash whole mountains away for their gold.

name: kutna-hora-silver-strike
description: A rich silver seam in Bohemia set off a boom that built a wealthy mining town and supplied the groschen coin to Europe.

name: joachimsthal-silver-rush
description: A silver strike in the Bohemian mountains led to the coins whose name gave the world the word dollar.

name: zacatecas-silver-strike
description: Prospectors in the Mexican highlands struck rich veins that launched a huge silver mining centre of the Spanish empire.

name: minas-gerais-gold-rush
description: Prospectors in the Brazilian interior found gold in river gravels, starting the first great gold rush of the Americas.

name: brazil-diamonds-discovered
description: Miners panning for gold in the Brazilian highlands noticed sparkling stones, ending India's long monopoly on diamonds.

name: berezovsk-first-russian-gold
description: A peasant found gold-bearing quartz in the Ural Mountains, opening the first gold mines of the Russian empire.

name: reed-gold-nugget-north-carolina
description: A boy fishing in a creek found a gold rock so heavy his family used it as a doorstop until a jeweller named its worth.

name: georgia-gold-rush
description: Gold found in the Appalachian foothills drew thousands of prospectors and the country's first big rush, before California.

name: eureka-diamond-found
description: Children found a sparkling pebble by a South African riverbank, the first diamond found there and a spark for later rushes.

name: kimberley-diamond-rush
description: A hill on a South African farm yielded so many diamonds that it became a vast hole dug mostly by hand.

name: tombstone-silver-strike
description: A prospector ignored warnings that he would find only his own grave and struck silver in the Arizona desert.

name: witwatersrand-gold-discovery
description: A reef of gold-bearing conglomerate was found on the South African highveld, and Johannesburg soon sprang up around it.

name: coolgardie-gold-rush
description: Nuggets picked up from the dry Western Australian scrub drew prospectors across the desert to a new boom town.

name: nome-beach-gold-rush
friendly_name: Gold on the Beach at Nome
description: Gold found in the sands of Alaska's Bering Sea coast drew thousands of hopefuls to dig on the shoreline itself.

name: cullinan-diamond-found
description: A mine manager spotted a gleam in a pit wall and pulled out the largest gem diamond ever discovered.

name: namib-diamond-rush
friendly_name: Diamonds Found in the Namib Desert
description: A railway worker shovelling sand in the Namibian desert picked up a diamond, starting a rush to a barren coast.

name: mir-siberian-diamond-pipe
description: A Soviet prospecting team found the first major diamond-bearing kimberlite pipe, opening a huge mine in frozen ground.

name: carlin-trend-gold-discovery
description: Geologists found microscopic gold invisible to the eye in Nevada rocks, unlocking one of the richest gold regions around.

name: orapa-diamond-pipe-found
description: Geologists tracing mineral grains across the Kalahari found a huge diamond pipe that would transform a poor nation.

name: serra-pelada-gold-rush
description: Tens of thousands of men swarmed a Brazilian hillside, hauling sacks of mud up ladders by hand in a giant open pit.

name: argyle-diamond-mine-opens
description: A remote mine in the Australian outback began production and became the main source of rare pink diamonds.

name: lac-de-gras-diamonds-found
description: After years searching the tundra, a geologist found diamond-bearing rock at Lac de Gras, launching a northern mining boom.

name: lesedi-la-rona-diamond-found
description: A Botswana mine's scanners picked out a stone the size of a tennis ball, the largest gem-quality rough diamond in a century.
